topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Oh my gosh, I just got this package, and it’s from Jake! Jake, of all people, my student from five years ago. I remember his last day in class, he was so quiet, barely a word. But now, this box, it’s like he’s saying hello all over again. I opened it, and there’s this handmade photo frame, and in it, a picture of the whole class, taken right outside the school. It’s in this big, clumsy font, "Thank you for everything" written on the back. I can’t believe he took the time to do this. It’s just... it’s so much, you know? Makes me think, maybe I made a difference.
